title: feat: news tabs for announcements, updates and changelog
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Enter’s news page replaces stacked Changelog and News sections with one panel containing Announcements, Updates and Changelog tabs, followed by the FAQ. Announcements opens first and shows hand-picked launches and changes as tinted cards with an icon, label, date, text and button. Entries expire after their `until` date, and the tab hides when none remain; initial entries cover the Nov 1 publishable key change, the new pollinations.ai website, Pay with crypto and Sandboxes. Updates shows daily product highlights in a two-column card grid. Daily summaries now label highlights `model`, `api` or `product`, and Updates excludes model and API highlights so those appear in the Changelog instead; README and social posts still use every highlight. The 131 existing highlights were labelled, but older unlabeled summaries remain visible in Updates and may duplicate Changelog entries. Changelog groups entries into one card per day and labels future days “Upcoming · Oct 20” rather than using a separate today divider. Header links follow the selected tab, and signed-out visitors can access all three tabs.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden newsroom, Polli wears a tiny newsboy cap and points to a warm cream retro screen with three simple tabs—Announcements, Updates and Changelog—while lime green (#ecf874) code-plants bloom around it. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene, strictly pixel art, with cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
